subject.title: feat(ui): session diff panel showing a session checkout's changes in chat

question: Should OpenClaw permanently own the new `sessions.diff` cross-client API and first-party Control UI review panel?
rationale: The implementation adds a new core Gateway contract and durable product workflow under a protected maintainer label; code correctness alone cannot establish that permanent ownership decision.

options.title: Sponsor the first-party workflow
options.body: Keep the additive API and capability-gated panel, requiring bounded Git execution, shared checkout resolution, conflict resolution, and real-browser proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the core surface
options.body: Redesign around a smaller generic workspace-read seam or fewer first-party entry points before accepting the feature.

options.title: Decline core ownership
options.body: Keep diff review in external git tools and close the paired issue and PR.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the first-party workflow
recommendation.body: Keep the additive API and capability-gated panel, requiring bounded Git execution, shared checkout resolution, conflict resolution, and real-browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest routing evidence is the merged ownership of the adjacent PR-chip and workspace-sidebar workflows, plus the current protected product proposal.
